CPU-profile interval attribution is sampled wall time, not a direct thread CPU clock; long sample gaps are reported separately. Negative CDP deltas require chronological sorting before disjoint interval attribution.

100ms cgroup intervals may bracket a short frame; overlap alone does not prove causation.
